experience.summary: Senior individual contributor owning technical design across the discovery-to-cart journey, plus the API layer behind a retail mobile app.
highlights: Architected and led the end-to-end PLP/PDP redesign, restructuring navigation and information architecture across the discovery-to-cart journey and cutting cart abandonment by 18%.

Own technical design decisions and sprint planning as a senior IC, mentor junior engineers, and run agile scrums to improve delivery velocity.

Integrated fraud detection and transaction verification providers, using asynchronous processing in Node.js to keep checkout latency low.

Developed automated test suites and administration scripts that raised release reliability and caught regressions earlier.
Diagnosed production bugs, drove targeted performance work, and stood up monitoring to track system health over time.
